title: Procedural Impossible-Space Authoring, Solvability & Diagnostics
objective: Implement MSLR recipe/profile authoring nodes over PCA-02/PCA-03; constrained seeded candidate generation; PCA-12 model/diagnostic adapters; reachability, solvability, contradiction and cycle diagnostics; Packet-07 creator preview/explanation/step-through; MCS specialist graph/map/frame views; governed promotion of valid candidates; and the approved fundamental-domain + transformation/group generation pattern with optional regular Schläfli {p,q} tiling validation.
acceptance: Recipe/profile nodes bind to PCA-02/PCA-03 authoring owners and do not create a second canonical content/recipe ledger.
Seeded candidate generation is deterministic where declared and remains noncanonical until governed promotion.
Reachability, solvability, contradiction and cycle diagnostics consume an MSLR model adapter over PCA-12 without silently repairing invalid designs.
Packet-07 creator preview/explanation/step-through is noncanonical and preserves hidden/owner boundaries.
MCS specialist map/graph/frame views remain projections rather than spatial truth.
Fundamental-domain plus explicit transformation/group generators can author repeated/identified impossible-space structure without exhaustive manual enumeration.

Regular Schläfli {p,q} validation is one optional specialized generator: spherical/Euclidean/hyperbolic classification may be validated for that recipe type but is never treated as a universal MSLR geometry rule.
Only validated candidates may be submitted to governed promotion; promotion routes through existing owner operations and provenance.
Blocking authoring/diagnostic workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, provider-off and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03/04/07/08/13 and upstream completed programs remain sealed.
PCA-02/PCA-03 retain canonical recipe/generator authoring ownership and PCA-12 retains analysis/model ownership.
Packet-07 remains creator preview/explanation authority; previews do not self-authorize canonical state.
GPR/Action/Event retain governed promotion execution and immutable Event provenance.
Regular tiling math is an optional specialized recipe validator, not a universal MSLR law.
External hyperbolic/HyperRogue references remain clean-room architecture guidance only; no protected implementation/expression is copied.
MSLR-16 and later tranches remain unauthorized until MSLR-14 closeout.
next_action: Await the next owner Continue. That command may governed-start only amended MSLR-14.
